metadata.notes: Single council — not amalgamated. Woollahra DCP 2015 (per-chapter PDFs, chapters A1/A3, B1–B4, C1–C3, D4, E1–E3/E5–E6). Heritage: B2 (Neighbourhood HCAs), C1 (Paddington HCA), C2 (Woollahra HCA), C3 (Watsons Bay HCA). Business centres: D4 (Edgecliff). Suburbs: Woollahra, Paddington, Double Bay, Watsons Bay, Rose Bay, Bellevue Hill, Point Piper, Edgecliff.
